title: Each region's share of total sales
objective: Work out a share of total as part divided by total, using an absolute reference for the total.
instructions: B7 already holds the total sales of the five regions. In C2:C6, work out each region's share of total: the region's sales divided by the total in B7. Write the formula so you can copy it down without changing the reference to the total (use $B$7). Answers are decimals, so 0.07 means 7%. In C7, add up the five shares with SUM.
hints: A share is the part divided by the total: =B2/B7. Dividing, not multiplying by 100, gives a decimal such as 0.25.
Put $ signs on the total, =B2/$B$7, so it stays on B7 when you copy the formula down. B2 should still change to B3, B4 and so on.
In C7, use =SUM(C2:C6). Shares of a complete total always add up to the whole, which is 100%.
